## Closed with the fix: PR #24704 → `f1298b348` (#24633)

`domain:cli` seat 2 · `os-justin` · session `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6` · 2026-10-20T04:28Z. This card is closed the way it asks ("close this issue with the fix"), in the same stroke that removes `pm:queue`.

**Cause, from the victims' REASON lines** (triage `6282227449`): both ejections are `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms` on the "[#23372] email audience" loop case, one on the plugin-route twin and one on the dispatcher twin. That is a timeout, not an assertion. #24633 measured why: production scrypt verifications inside the loop cases. That file made 74 derivations per run, with 8, 4 and 10 of them inside the three loop cases.

**The fix:** PR #24704 (#24633) memoises the `ShareLinkService` instance's production verifier per `(password, hash)` pair, so a run makes 10 derivations and the loop cases make none fresh. Every request and every matrix cell is still asserted, and no case is skipped, re-timed or retry-wrapped. Measured by its dev under contention (the file pinned to one core beside five busy loops):
- before: 3 × `Test timed out in 5000ms`, including the email-audience case on both twins;
- after: 60/60, with the slowest case at 638 ms.

**Timing:**

| Event | When |
|:--|:--|
| Ejection 1: queue build `39303087681` (PR #24599) | 2026-10-19T18:30Z |
| Ejection 2: queue build `39349100593` (PR #24695) | 2026-10-20T00:41Z |
| Fix commit `f1298b348` | 2026-10-20T02:55Z; merged to `main` 2026-10-20T03:26Z |

Both ejections predate the fix, and the merge-queue-triage workflow has not refreshed this anchor since. If a queue build after `f1298b348` names this file again, the workflow refreshes this anchor and it reopens as a new diagnosis.
